_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ia sampun dados Pemain {player_id}, maplajah {num_rounds} puteran Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ia madué $ {pool} mangda kakepah ring puteran puniki riantara Ia miwah Pemain {other_id}.

Ngajuang:
  - Ngajuang tawaran: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Yén kadampiang → Ia ngamolihang $(pool - X), pemain liyanan ngamolihang $X
  - Yén katuju → Kakekalih ngamolihang $0
  - Conto: [Offer: $3]  utawi  'Kulen ngintip tawaran puniki becik. [Offer: $5]'

Ngampiang:
  - Ngripta tawaran sareng [Accept] utawi [Reject]
  - Conto: 'Tawaran puniki becik. [Accept]'
            'Kulen tuah nenten becik. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Puteran {round_number} sampun kawitin! ---
Pemain {proposer_id} dados ngajuang, Pemain {responder_id} dados ngampiang.
round.accepted: Pemain {responder_id} ngampiang! Puteran {round_number} ngasil: Pemain {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Pemain {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Akéh anyar: Pemain 0: ${total_0}, Pemain 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Pemain {responder_id} nulak tawaran! Puteran {round_number} ngasil: Kakekalih pemain +$0. Akéh tetep: Pemain 0: ${total_0}, Pemain 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Sang sané ngusulang mangda makarya penawaran nganggén format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Jumlah tawaran patut dados wilangan bulat sané valid.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Nénten wénten tawaran sané mangkin antuk naur.

outcome.win: Pemain {winner} menang antuk ${winner_total} akéh vs Pemain {loser} akéh ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Imbang! Kakekalih pemain puput antuk ${total} akéh.
